When I first read about this cream, nothing about it really impressed me. Then i got a 1 oz trial size with my purchase so i decided to give it a shot. This cream definitely took me by surprise with how nice it made my skin feel. The consistency is close to a gel-cream, leaning more towards the cream side. I have an oily t-zone then normal everywhere else. I get an occasional hormonal breakout depending on where i am on my cycle but what i struggle most with is texture around my nose so i do try to avoid super thick creams. That being said, one of my favorite things about this cream is how versatile it is. Ive worn it under my sunscreen with a full face of makeup. Not only did my makeup look flawless but i also noticed how hydrated and plump my skin looked without getting greasy even on hot/ humid days. Then at night, I'm able to skip my usual thick second moisturizer as my last step because this cream is able to keep me moisturized and hydrated all night long. On the mornings after applying this as my last step, I've woken up with really soft and plump skin! Im excited to see how this cream holds up during the colder months. Something is telling me that i won't have any issues with it though. 10/10 would recommend!
I loved this lotion, its hydrating and made a huge difference in my skin. The texture is perfect, its super hydrating without feeling heavy or oily. Def a must have in your skin care routine.

I love love this product. I see the results in my skin after 2wks. My skin looks healthy and vibrant. I rarely wear make-up, but even when I do, my skin still glows!! I absolutely love this product!!!!
This moisturizer is the best I've ever used. It's not greasy and leaves my skin so hydrated.

avis.titre: Great applicator, absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling
avis.texte: I trust Korean skin care products and always love trying new ones. This moisturizer is nice! It comes in a decently sized bottle and the applicator makes it feel pretty high end. It's not overly thick. It's more lightweight but leaves my skin feeling moisturized as well as thicker creams. It is absorbed quickly and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or sticky. I prefer to use it at night but I think it would also work well under makeup. I don't detect any scent with it which I appreciate. This is my first time using a moisturizer with salmon PDRN and I can't wait to see the long term benefits of it!
